title: The worked package of appendix B, a manifest, one input with its schema and meaning document, two templates and one example, is checked with no finding, passes its test, and packs into <name>-<version>.metais, which opens
notes: Appendix B shows every file of package/ and builds it step by step; worked-package-check and worked-package-test are its two drafts. The example supplies its input as YAML from examples/lantern/inputs/, and expects release-2.4.0.md, whose name the notes output's path template computes from the version, and announcement.txt, the announcement template's path with .liquid removed. The expected package was written by metais pack and is compared by entries.
